boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented UC Davis and Davis activities with no admission or purchase required.

cards.entity_name: UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden
cards.title: Walk the Arboretum paths
cards.subtitle: UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden
cards.notes: Meet at a garden entrance, choose a loop from the visitor map, and take an unhurried walk beside the plant collections.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced outdoor walk through UC Davis gardens and landscapes.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis states there is no charge to visit its Arboretum and Public Garden, whose gardens, natural areas, and landscapes are open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Visit and Explore — UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden
cards.access_notes: Outdoor areas are open 24 hours daily; vehicle parking may require payment on weekdays.

cards.title: Follow the Putah Creek reserve
cards.subtitle: UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden
cards.notes: Use the Arboretum visitor information to plan a daylight walk through this creek-and-grassland section of the campus landscape.
cards.short_summary: A nature-focused stroll in UC Davis’s managed creek reserve.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis identifies the Putah Creek Riparian Reserve as part of the Arboretum and Public Garden and states there is no charge to visit its natural areas.
cards.source_title: Visit and Explore — UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden
cards.access_notes: Use established public paths and observe posted stewardship guidance; weekday visitor parking can cost extra.

cards.title: Watch pollinators at Bee Haven
cards.subtitle: UC Davis Bee Haven
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a slow garden lap, read the planting labels, and give the working pollinator habitat plenty of space.
cards.short_summary: A public pollinator garden with more than 200 supporting plant species.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis says Bee Haven is open and free to the public daily from dawn to dusk, including weekends and holidays.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk. Stay on paths and avoid disturbing bees and other pollinators.

cards.title: Take a self-guided conservatory visit
cards.subtitle: UC Davis Botanical Conservatory, Kleiber Hall Drive
cards.notes: Go as a small group, check availability before leaving, and explore the greenhouse’s plant collections at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A no-reservation visit among tropical, desert, and carnivorous plants.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis says self-guided visits for small groups are always free and require no reservation.
cards.source_title: Tour the Conservatory — UC Davis Botanical Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Drop-in visitors are welcome, but UC Davis asks visitors to call or email ahead because staffing is limited; normal hours are weekdays.

cards.title: See live insects and specimens
cards.subtitle: Bohart Museum of Entomology, UC Davis
cards.notes: Check the museum’s same-day status, then browse the public displays and live insects and arachnids during walk-in hours.
cards.short_summary: A compact campus museum visit centered on insects and arachnids.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bohart Museum states that individuals and families may walk in for free to explore its displays and live insects and arachnids during select hours.
cards.source_title: Visiting the Museum — Bohart Museum of Entomology
cards.access_notes: Public walk-in hours are listed as Tuesdays and Wednesdays, 1–4:30 p.m. when UC Davis is in session; check for staffing closures first.

cards.entity_name: Jan Shrem and Maria Manetti Shrem Museum of Art
cards.title: Browse the Manetti Shrem galleries
cards.subtitle: 254 Old Davis Road, UC Davis
cards.notes: Visit the galleries with time to look closely, then stop by the drop-in Parker Art Studio if it is open to visitors.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary-art museum with exhibitions and an on-site drop-in studio.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis lists admission to the Jan Shrem and Maria Manetti Shrem Museum of Art as free for all.
cards.source_title: Manetti Shrem Museum Fall 2025 Exhibitions — UC Davis
cards.access_notes: Confirm current gallery hours and exhibition dates before going; admission is free, while parking policies vary.

cards.title: Browse Shields Library collections
cards.subtitle: Shields Library, UC Davis main campus
cards.notes: Pick a floor, browse the stacks or use an in-library workstation, and keep the visit low-key around other library users.
cards.short_summary: A public-research-library stop for browsing books and on-site resources.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis Library welcomes the public to visit Shields Library; people physically present can access collections in the stacks and many digital resources on library workstations.
cards.source_title: Non-Affiliate Access to UC Davis Library Collections
cards.access_notes: Public visitation and in-building collection access do not require a purchase; borrowing privileges and some services have separate rules.

cards.title: Take the raptor self-guided route
cards.subtitle: California Raptor Center, UC Davis School of Veterinary Medicine
cards.notes: Keep your group to six or fewer, follow the posted route, and pause at the placards for each non-releasable bird’s story.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided viewing route with resident raptors and a museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The California Raptor Center states that its self-guided tours, including its raptor route and museum, have free admission.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit — California Raptor Center
cards.access_notes: Visiting hours are 9 a.m.–4 p.m. Monday–Friday and 9 a.m.–noon Saturday–Sunday; closed university holidays.

cards.title: Find all five Eggheads
cards.subtitle: UC Davis campus
cards.notes: Open the Arts at UC Davis interactive map, walk to each installation, and scan the labels’ QR codes for the background.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided campus art walk linking five Egghead installations.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis provides an Egghead Art Walk using its interactive map and says all five installations have informational labels and QR codes.
cards.source_title: Take a Self-Guided Campus Art Tour — UC Davis
cards.access_notes: The listed self-guided-tour event runs 8 a.m.–8 p.m.; stay on public campus routes and observe building access rules.

cards.title: Pause by Lake Spafford
cards.subtitle: East Asian Collection, UC Davis Arboretum
cards.notes: Bring a no-purchase picnic or simply sit on the open lawn, taking in the lake view and seasonal trees from the paths.
cards.short_summary: An Arboretum collection with lawns, Lake Spafford views, and seasonal plant interest.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis describes the East Asian Collection as an Arboretum destination with open lawns and views of Lake Spafford; the Arboretum states there is no charge to visit its gardens.
cards.source_title: Visit and Explore — UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden
cards.access_notes: The broader Arboretum gardens are open 24 hours daily; avoid reserved areas and note that weekday vehicle parking may cost extra.
